items.title: George Kittle: Critical fumble in Week 7 loss
items.text:
Kittle brought in eight of 10 targets for 88 yards and lost a fumble in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Career-high passing yardage in loss
items.text:
Huntley completed 23 of 34 passes for 298 yards with a touchdown and an interception while adding three rushes for 12 yards in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Engineers another comeback win
items.text:
Watson completed 25 of 36 passes for 308 yards with an interception in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans. He added 19 yards and a touchdown on three carries.

items.title: Chuba Hubbard: Garners 11 touches in loss
items.text:
Hubbard rushed seven times for 33 yards and brought in four of five targets for 27 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Elevated opportunity in easy win
items.text:
Gainwell rushed 14 times for 88 yards and returned one kickoff for 30 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.

items.title: KC Concepcion: Huge day against Titans
items.text:
Concepcion caught eight of 10 targets for 129 yards and added 23 yards on three carries in Sunday's 27-24 win over Tennessee.
